# Claude Code 2.1.280 — plugins e MCP

Resumo verificado em 2026-09-22 contra os docs oficiais; detalhes nas fontes.

- Plugins: a plugin is a self-contained folder; only `.claude-plugin/plugin.json` goes inside `.claude-plugin/`; `skills/`, `commands/`, `agents/`, `hooks/hooks.json`, `workflows/`, `.mcp.json`, `.lsp.json`, `monitors/monitors.json`, `bin/`, `settings.json` (only `agent` and `subagentStatusLine` keys) sit at the plugin root. A `CLAUDE.md` at the plugin root is NOT loaded, so the Gabriel persona must stay in the project `CLAUDE.md`. Only `name` is required in plugin.json; `skills` path ADDS to the default scan, `commands`/`agents`/`workflows` REPLACE. `${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}`, `${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA}`, `${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}` are exported to hook/MCP/LSP processes but NOT to commands Claude runs through the Bash tool. Plugin agents ignore `hooks`, `mcpServers`, `permissionMode`, `initialPrompt`; project `.claude/agents/` override plugin agents of the same name. Load locally with `claude --plugin-dir ./dir`, `claude plugin init` (skills-dir plugin `<name>@skills-dir`), or a local marketplace (`/plugin marketplace add ./mkt`, relative `source` must start with `./` unless a bare name under `metadata.pluginRoot`, v2.1.239+; loads in place, no version bump). Recommendation for babel-os: standalone `.claude/` + `CLAUDE.md`; plugin only as an export layer.
- MCP: project `.mcp.json` = `{"mcpServers": {"name": {"type": "stdio", "command": "...", "args": [...], "env": {...}, "timeout": <ms>, "alwaysLoad": bool}}}`; missing `type` means stdio; `url` without `type` is an error. `${VAR}`/`${VAR:-default}` expand in command/args/env/url/headers; use `${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}`. Scopes: local (~/.claude.json), project (.mcp.json), user (~/.claude.json); precedence local > project > user > plugin > claude.ai connectors. Project servers need interactive approval (`claude mcp reset-project-choices`); `enableAllProjectMcpServers`/`enabledMcpjsonServers` in the project's committed `.claude/settings.json` are ignored until the workspace is trusted (user settings, managed, `--settings` still apply); `disabledMcpjsonServers` always applies. `alwaysLoad: true` makes startup wait for that server (max 5 s); others connect in background unless `MCP_CONNECTION_NONBLOCKING=0`. Tool names: `mcp__<server>__<tool>`; plugin servers `mcp__plugin_<plugin>_<server>__<tool>`; hook matcher for a whole server needs `mcp__x__.*`; permission rule `mcp__x__*`. `claude mcp add --transport http|sse|stdio <name> [url | -- cmd args]`, `claude mcp add-json <name> '<json>'`.
- Hooks (settings.json and hooks/hooks.json share the same `hooks` object): matcher is exact string when it contains only letters, digits, `_`, `-`, spaces, `,`, `|` (split on `|` or `,`), otherwise an unanchored JS regex; exception: `FileChanged`/`StopFailure` allow only letters, digits, `_`, `|` in exact mode. Matchers use bare tool names; filter arguments with the handler `if` field (permission-rule syntax, tool events only). On macOS `Glob`/`Grep` are absent by default: searches arrive as `Bash`. Handler fields: `type`, `command`, `args` (exec form, no shell), `async`, `asyncRewake`, `shell`, `if`, `timeout` (SECONDS; default 600, 30 on UserPromptSubmit, 10 on MessageDisplay), `statusMessage`, `once` (skills only). SessionEnd hooks share a 1.5 s budget: set per-hook `timeout` (raises budget to max 60 s) or `CLAUDE_CODE_SESSIONEND_HOOKS_TIMEOUT_MS`. Hooks merge across user/project/local; `disableAllHooks` (project `false` beats user `true`; `--settings '{"disableAllHooks": true}'` for one run).
- Hook stdin JSON: common `session_id`, `prompt_id`, `transcript_path` (async, may lag), `cwd`, `scratchpad_dir`, `permission_mode` ("default"|"plan"|"acceptEdits"|"auto"|"dontAsk"|"bypassPermissions"), `effort`, `hook_event_name`, plus `agent_id`/`agent_type` in subagents. UserPromptSubmit adds `prompt`; SessionStart adds `source` (startup|resume|clear|compact|fork), `model`, `agent_type`, `session_title`; SessionEnd adds `reason`; PreToolUse adds `tool_name`, `tool_input`, `tool_use_id`; PostToolUse adds `tool_response`, `duration_ms` (Bash: `tool_response.bashEditDiff` v2.1.269+); Stop/SubagentStop add `stop_hook_active`, `last_assistant_message`, `background_tasks`, `session_crons` (+`agent_transcript_path`). tool_input keys: Bash `command`,`description`,`timeout`(ms),`run_in_background`; Write `file_path`,`content`; Edit `file_path`,`old_string`,`new_string`,`replace_all`; Read `file_path`,`offset`,`limit`; WebFetch `url`,`prompt`; WebSearch `query`; Agent `prompt`,`description`,`subagent_type`,`model`. file_path is always absolute.
- Hook output: exit 0 stdout goes to context only on UserPromptSubmit/UserPromptExpansion/SessionStart/PostModelSwitch; JSON `{"hookSpecificOutput": {"hookEventName": "<Event>", "additionalContext": "..."}}` injects memory; `systemMessage` shows a warning to the user; `additionalContext`/`systemMessage`/`initialUserMessage`/plain stdout capped at 10,000 chars. Exit 2 blocks on PreToolUse/UserPromptSubmit/Stop/SubagentStop/PreCompact etc.; ignored on PermissionRequest, PermissionDenied, Notification, Setup, StopFailure; on PostToolUse it only shows stderr to Claude. Exit 1 never blocks. SessionEnd discards JSON output. SessionStart (also Setup, CwdChanged, FileChanged) gets `CLAUDE_ENV_FILE`: append `export VAR=...` lines to persist env vars for later Bash commands.
- Tools and permissions: exact built-in tool names listed in §1.6/§11; `TodoWrite` disabled by default and Task tools only on older models unless `CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_TODO_TOOLS=1`. Bash: `cd` persists inside the project in the main session only (`CLAUDE_BASH_MAINTAIN_PROJECT_WORKING_DIR=1` disables), `export` does not persist, read-only commands (ls, cat, grep, find, git read forms...) run without prompts. Permission rules: `Bash(python3 scripts/*)` prefix; `Edit(/memoria/**)` in project `.claude/settings.json` = `<project>/memoria/**` but `/path` in `~/.claude/settings.json` = `~/.claude/path`; Edit allow grants read; Read deny blocks Edit/Write; path rules for Write/NotebookEdit/Glob/MultiEdit are never consulted (except a Glob rule in `--allowedTools`); `WebFetch(domain:code.claude.com)`; `WebSearch` bare; parameter rules `Tool(param:value)` only in deny/ask. Do not write `Bash(python3 "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"/scripts/*)`: that variable is empty in Bash tool commands.
